title: Essentially constant filtered ind-diagram
statement: Let $J$ be a filtered category, $\mathcal C$ a category, and $F : J \to \mathcal C$ a functor. We say that $F$ is essentially constant with value $X$ in the ind-category if there are morphisms $p_j : F(j) \to X$ natural in $j$, an index $j_0$ and a morphism $s : X \to F(j_0)$ with $p_{j_0} \circ s = \operatorname{id}_X$, and such that for every $j$ there is an index $k$ with morphisms $j_0 \to k$ and $j \to k$ for which the transition map $F(j) \to F(k)$ equals the composite $F(j) \xrightarrow{p_j} X \xrightarrow{s} F(j_0) \to F(k)$, where the last map is induced by the chosen morphism $j_0 \to k$.
